title: Manifest-signature corpus index
description: Machine-readable manifest of the manifest-signature cases, so a runner in any language consumes the corpus without parsing prose. The index IS the corpus: a case file no entry here lists is executed by nothing.

spec.description: The normative document this corpus is the executable form of.

file.description: Case path relative to this directory. No path separators in the filename, so an entry cannot reach outside the corpus.

section.description: The specification section this case pins. The wider, subsection-capable form the diagnostics and canonical-json corpora use, so a later §8.1 is nameable without a schema change.
